title: Online meeting of the Green and Digital Universities Steering Committee

blocks.text: On 10 February 2024, the steering committee of the Green and Digital Universities for Sustainable Development of Kyrgyzstan project, funded by the EU Erasmus+ programme, held its first online meeting. Participants discussed the first stage of project implementation, implementation of Work Package 1, the questionnaire for SWOT analysis and benchmarking, and a review of Work Package 5.
